study type: Retrospective analysis of prospectively gathered data
outcome: Incidence of obstetric anal sphincter injury
cohort: Secundiparous women with a previous caesarean delivery who had a trial of labor from 2001 to 2011 at a tertiary referral university institution
finding: This study found a 5% incidence of anal sphincter injury in women undergoing VBAC, with birth weight and instrumental delivery being strong predictors of this outcome.
birth_weight: Mentioned as a strong predictor of anal sphincter injury, but no specific range provided
